method: Each rule is scored against the days on which it could have fired. The baseline excludes trigger days and the 90 days after each trigger, so it is not contaminated by the aftermath of the signal. Top rules are scored on a 40% fall within 365 days; bottom rules on a doubling within 365 days. Episodes whose window is incomplete are excluded and counted as censored. In-sample and descriptive: this measures what followed, not what will follow.

rules.name: Pi Cycle Top
rules.claim: The 111-day average crossing above twice the 350-day average marks a cycle top.

rules.name: Mayer multiple above 2.4
rules.claim: Price at 2.4x its 200-day average is an overheated market.

rules.name: Price below the 200-week average
rules.claim: Price under its 200-week average is a generational buying zone.

rules.name: Price below the 2-year average
rules.claim: The 2-year moving average multiplier marks the accumulation band.

rules.name: Golden cross
rules.claim: The 50-day crossing above the 200-day average starts a bull phase.

rules.name: Death cross
rules.claim: The 50-day crossing below the 200-day average starts a bear phase.

rules.name: RSI-14 above 70
rules.claim: An overbought RSI precedes a fall.

rules.name: RSI-14 below 30
rules.claim: An oversold RSI precedes a rally.

rules.name: MVRV above 3.7
rules.claim: An MVRV above 3.7 marks the top of the cycle.

rules.name: MVRV below 1
rules.claim: An MVRV below 1 means the average holder is under water: a bottom.

rules.name: Puell multiple below 0.4
rules.claim: Miner revenue far below its yearly average marks a cycle low.

rules.name: Puell multiple above 4
rules.claim: Miner revenue far above its yearly average marks a cycle top.

rules.name: MVRV Z-score below zero
rules.claim: Market value below realised value, in standard deviations, marks the bottom.

rules.name: MVRV Z-score above 5
rules.claim: An extreme Z-score marks the top of the cycle.

rules.name: Market cap under 10x thermocap
rules.claim: Market value close to everything ever paid to miners marks a cycle low.

rules.name: Price below realised price
rules.claim: When price falls under what the average holder paid, the bottom is in.

rules.name: Price below the balanced price
rules.claim: A deeper floor than realised price, reached only in the worst bear markets.

rules.name: Stablecoin supply ratio in its lowest tenth
rules.claim: Plenty of dry powder relative to market value precedes a rally.

rules.name: Weekly RSI below 30
rules.claim: An oversold weekly RSI marks the bottom of a bear market.

rules.name: Monthly RSI below 40
rules.claim: A monthly RSI at bear-market levels marks the bottom.

rules.name: One-year return below -50%
rules.claim: A full reset of the trailing year marks the capitulation low.

rules.name: Price reclaims the 50-week average
rules.claim: A convincing close back above the 50-week average confirms the low is in.

rules.name: Transaction fees in their lowest twentieth
rules.claim: Fees as low as at previous bottoms mean the chain is as quiet as it gets.

rules.name: Public attention in its lowest sixth
rules.claim: Nobody is looking: the condition that precedes a recovery.

rules.name: Public attention in its highest tenth
rules.claim: Everybody is looking: the condition that marks a top.

rules.name: Our composite reads cheap (below 30)
rules.claim: When our own valuation composite is in its cheap band, a doubling follows.

rules.name: Our composite reads dear (above 70)
rules.claim: When our own valuation composite is in its dear band, a 40% fall follows.

rules.name: Our composite reads very cheap (below 10)
rules.claim: When our composite is in its lowest band, a doubling follows.

rules.name: Our composite reads very dear (above 90)
rules.claim: When our composite is in its highest band, a 40% fall follows.

rules.name: Price in the power-law model's bottom fifth
rules.claim: When price sits in the lowest fifth of its power-law deviation history, a doubling follows.

rules.name: Price in the power-law model's top fifth
rules.claim: When price sits in the highest fifth of its power-law deviation history, a 40% fall follows.

rules.name: Fear and Greed at 20 or below
rules.claim: Extreme fear means the market has capitulated and it is time to buy.

rules.name: Fear and Greed at 80 or above
rules.claim: Extreme greed means the market is euphoric and due to fall.

rules.name: Hash ribbon capitulation
rules.claim: When the 30-day hash rate falls below the 60-day, miners are capitulating and a bottom is near.

rules.name: Price below the Stock-to-Flow model
rules.claim: Bitcoin trades below its scarcity-implied value and will revert to it.

rules.name: LPPLS bubble model
rules.claim: A log-periodic power-law fit identifies a bubble approaching its critical time.

critical_time.rule: one trial per signal run: at its first day, did the highest close of the following 365 days fall within the tolerance of the fitted t_c; baseline = random start days with t_c offsets resampled from the runs
